dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user:
Hello, I'm in the market for a new pair of shoes and I'm hoping you can help me find something that fits my needs. I have a budget of $200 to $500 and I'm looking for shoes that have at least a 4 out of 5 star average rating. The reviews and number of reviews are also important to me. 

I'm particularly interested in shoes that are casual, athletic, and comfortable. Could you please provide some options that meet those criteria? I'd like to learn more about the features and reviews of the shoes you suggest.
dialogue.agent: The **Mephisto Women's Yael Oxford** seems like a good match for your preferences. It is within your $200-$500 price range at $249, has a high 4.3 out of 5 star average rating based on 34 reviews, and is described as a comfortable, durable walking shoe made with high-quality materials. The detailed product description highlights its features like being 100% leather, having a synthetic sole, and providing "miles of pain-free walking." Let me know if you would like me to look up any additional options that fit your criteria.

Several customers highlighted how the shoes help alleviate foot pain and issues like plantar fasciitis, allowing them to walk long distances without any discomfort. The reviews also emphasize the high-quality construction and materials used in these shoes.

top_reviews.title: cleaning issue
top_reviews.text: These shoes were very comfortable, right out of the box.  I wore them most days of a 10-day trip on terrain ranging from cobblestones to bike paths, and they were great.  Unfortunately, the spaces between the mottled or crackly finish on the silver shoes are impossible to clean.  Since I bought them in two sizes, I was able to take this photo, which was taken after I used a high-quality leather cleaner--no luck.  At this point, they are wearable only for very casual use.

top_reviews.title: The best of the five new pairs of shoes I had ...
top_reviews.text: The best of the  five new pairs of shoes I had to buy because of  problem with the nail on a big toe. The toe area is soft and roomy.  It's padding is only second to good running shoes.

top_reviews.title: No more feet issues
top_reviews.text:
They are the best shoe ever; I have plantar fasciitis (or did have) and since wearing these I can walk my 3-4 miles a day with NO pain. Have tried taping, cheap splints, physical therapy but nothing helped until I found these shoes.
Nothing like Mephisto and I bought another pair so I can have them when they other wears out.
I cannot say enough great things about this shoe. If you want comfort and durability then this shoe is for you.
